name: r61_ci_pillow
title: CI installs the test suite's one third-party dependency (Pillow)
intro: R61 (2026-10-16): the R59 workflow assumed the whole suite is stdlib-only, but tests/test_r52_app_icon.py imports PIL at module level (R52/R53 icon pixel pins) -- on a clean runner the module died at import, the 13 icon pins vanished behind one loader error and CI ran 922 tests instead of 934/932. The gate job now installs Pillow before the suite, the misleading 'no pip install needed' comment is corrected (stdlib-only is true for the APP, not the TESTS), and three pins keep it honest: Pillow is installed, it is installed BEFORE the suite, and the icon pins keep their module-level PIL import (a missing Pillow must stay a loud error, never a silent skip).
markers: the stdlib-only comment is corrected honestly
regenerated manual keeps its generated appendix
commit_message: R61: CI installs Pillow for the icon pixel pins (missing PIL hid 13 pins behind one loader error)
